verdict.rationale: cubic ships an official CLI that runs from the terminal and reviews uncommitted local changes (`cubic review`). It can use a connected ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription for these local reviews. However, the CLI is a review agent rather than a general coding agent: it finds bugs and produces a prompt that a separate coding agent must use to write the fixes. Missing for 10: a general-purpose local coding agent that edits and writes code itself from the terminal, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI workflow.
